transition.headline: One clear movement is enough
transition.help: Choose a short reveal, camera move or moment of your work. Check the phone crop. Add wording in the editor, not inside the footage. A scroll transition does not need to loop.
transition.export_recipe: MP4 with H.264 video, 1080p, 24 or 30 fps is the proposed pilot recipe. Server inspection and conversion must be implemented before claiming uploader support.
transition.support_status: No upload processor is enabled by this template.

framing.desktop: 1920 x 1080 is a useful landscape starting point.
framing.phone: An optional 1080 x 1920 portrait version can preserve a different composition. Otherwise approve the crop.
framing.limits: The editor must show actual dimensions, rotation, selected duration and upload/processing limits from server policy.

music.help: Choose your recording or upload through the existing music flow. Selling uses an approved offer, payment confirmation and download entitlement. Do not expose a paid master as the public player source.

native_video.help: Choose your existing native video post, or upload through the native publishing flow. Pinning references that post; it does not silently make a private or removed post public.

immersive360.help: Use a real 360 panorama or supported 360 video. An ordinary flat clip does not become a 360 scene. The visitor chooses Enter and can exit at any time.
immersive360.production_offer: A separately scoped capture/production service can supply an experience; no fee or vendor is activated here.

playback.help: Automatic start can be requested only after the visitor enables sound and the browser permits playback. Always retain a Play button. Transition motion never scrubs song audio.

modes.cinematic: Each configured transition precedes its content tile. Reduced motion omits the transitions, not the content.

account.help: The real demo is public. Using and saving the template requires a free M Account. Profile identity and branded website publishing remain distinct. Preserve selected template and draft through sign-in.
account.pricing_status: Free hosting limits, $5 social access and $33 tool bundles are proposals, not active billing plans.
